context.title: Context capacity
context.description: Maximum input positions in a forward pass.

checkpoint_sha256.title: Checkpoint identity
checkpoint_sha256.description: SHA-256 identity of the exact artifact bytes or canonical checkpoint.

tokenizer_sha256.title: Tokenizer identity
tokenizer_sha256.description: SHA-256 identity of the exact artifact bytes or canonical checkpoint.

dispatch.title: Direct dispatch
dispatch.description: One in-process execution endpoint; no router, queue, network or placement simulation.

max_new_tokens.title: Maximum new tokens
max_new_tokens.description: An upper bound on selected IDs, including TURN_END. Generation may stop earlier.

text.title: Request input
text.description: Exact user text; no normalization or truncation.
text.default: ann has the cup. ben has the book. who has the cup?

display_delta.title: Diagnostic text published to the output collector
display_delta.description: Diagnostic token display; raw IDs are authoritative. Control, byte, and hex IDs appear as labeled markers.

published_tokens.title: Published IDs
published_tokens.description: Every selected ID except TURN_END, including diagnostic control/byte/hex tokens.

unused_budget.title: Unused allowance
unused_budget.description: Requested ceiling minus actual selected ID count.

complete.title: Turn complete
complete.description: True only if TURN_END was selected.

SystemConfigurationPreview.title: Inference system
SystemConfigurationPreview.description: Expandable mechanism configuration preview; independent of the executed system binding.

WorkloadTransformationPreview.title: Input transformations
WorkloadTransformationPreview.description: Rules over the data-plane source input. Nonzero choices preview an intended workload transformation; the baseline does not generate variants, random messages, or timed arrivals.

TokenStepRequest.description: One next-token invocation: exact raw prefix and supplied continuation, without chat framing. Generation budget counts the continuation, not the prefix.

arrival_us.title: Declared virtual arrival; not service latency
arrival_us.description: Declared virtual arrival; not service latency

output_display.description: Diagnostic token display; raw IDs are authoritative. Control, byte, and hex IDs appear as labeled markers.

primary.description: Primary subject; must name an admitted ontology concept.

related.description: Other associated concepts; excludes the primary subject.

ConfigurationPreview.title: Configuration preview
ConfigurationPreview.description: Workload transformation, mechanism and client choices over separately supplied data-plane input. Preview choices are not accepted execution settings; recorded evidence remains separately bound.

PreparedInput.description: Validated model and workload binding with encoded input; no forward pass, selected output or execution identity.

record_json.title: Exported evidence
record_json.description: Exact exported JSON bytes; preserve numeric lexemes for replay.

run_id.title: Observed run
run_id.description: Current accepted computation identity; null before the first step or after reset.

position.title: Sequence position
position.description: Single selected position in the accepted sequence; determines the exact prefix for Next Token. The recorded computation is derived from this position.

observation_id.title: Executed observation
observation_id.description: Exact observation ID within the selected pass, or null for request and output inspection.

surface.title: Inspection surface
surface.description: Single detail and diagram focus; model requires an observation in the selected computation.

AttentionConfiguration.title: Attention
AttentionConfiguration.description: Configuration preview. Only causal softmax executes in the landing model; KDA selects the affected stage, not replacement weights or tensors.

display_so_far.description: Diagnostic token display; raw IDs are authoritative. Control, byte, and hex IDs appear as labeled markers.

output_bytes.description: Cumulative application-output bytes consumed; excludes protocol framing. A declared action, not proof that bytes were available.

ClientConfigurationPreview.title: Client
ClientConfigurationPreview.description: Client configuration preview. Paused marks the receiving boundary; no network, buffer, or backpressure execution is implied.

content.description: Canonical JSON bytes decoded as UTF-8; must match the referenced digest and declared schema before consumption.

display_so_far.description: Diagnostic token display; raw IDs are authoritative. Control, byte, and hex IDs appear as labeled markers.

output_display.description: Diagnostic token display; raw IDs are authoritative. Control, byte, and hex IDs appear as labeled markers.
